audit.whatIsWrong: Three strings said Ragnarok 'cleanses his pillar' / 'ignores his slow zone', one calling it a 'pillar root'. The page also never mentioned King's Tribute, and described Frozen Domain only as a move-speed zone.
audit.why: Pillar of Ice is impassable TERRAIN, not crowd control — Ragnarok's immunity to disables has nothing to act on, and a player who ults into a pillar expecting to walk through it simply stops moving. The mirror's biggest finding applies here from the other side too: Subjugate is a stat theft, not a disable, so it lands straight through Ragnarok, and Ragnarok's own passive armour and MR are part of what Subjugate takes a percentage of. Frozen Domain also amplifies healing from all sources, and King's Tribute heals him off every unit dying nearby — together they are what the anti-heal is actually for.
audit.corrected: Removed all three cleanse-the-pillar claims and replaced them with the walk-around-terrain rule; wrote in Subjugate-as-stat-theft including the Ragnarok interaction; named King's Tribute, Chomp (3.5s), Frozen Domain, Pillar of Ice (21s) and Subjugate.

edits.before: Trundle is one of the few drain-tanks you don't just run over, so respect his Q bite — every time it lands it steals your attack damage and feeds him, weakening your autos and your passive ramp. Still, levels 1-3 are yours: land Q to slow, walk up, and weave E true damage between autos before he has any sustain stacked. Don't dump E when his pillar (E) is up to wall you off — bait it, then commit. Short trades favor you here because his healing isn't online yet.
edits.after: Trundle is one of the few drain-tanks you don't just run over, so respect Chomp — every bite steals your attack damage and it is back up in 3.5s. King's Tribute also heals him off every minion that dies near him, so he is never as low as the bar suggests. Still, levels 1-3 are yours: land Q to slow, walk up, and weave E true damage before his sustain is stacked. Pillar of Ice is 21s at rank 1 — bait it, then commit, because it is terrain you walk around, not CC you push through.

edits.before: Levels 4-6 even out as his Q-bite AD steal and W move-speed zone let him sustain and reposition out of your axe slows. Keep forcing short all-ins where your W omnivamp and E burst beat his raw drain, but don't extend into a fight he can kite with W and reset with his pillar. At 6 your Ragnarok is the equalizer — it cleanses his pillar root and ignores his slow zone, so you can still dive him through peel, but his own R isn't far behind and he's no longer free to all-in.
edits.after: Levels 4-6 even out as Chomp's AD steal and Frozen Domain's speed and healing amp let him sustain and reposition out of your axe slows. Keep forcing short all-ins where Tough It Out's shield and your E burst beat his raw drain, but don't extend into a fight he can kite with W and reset with a pillar. At 6 Ragnarok is not the equalizer the lane wants: Pillar of Ice is terrain it cannot cancel and Subjugate is a stat theft it cannot block, so time the dive on his cooldowns.

edits.before: This is where Trundle pulls ahead. Convert your early lead into towers, plates and dives before two items — if it goes long and even, his drain-tank scaling quietly wins the lane.
